source_disposition: Live stable main49abbb017 with merged export-probe preservation through route churn; supersedes unmeasured c4639 preparation without combining source versions.
admission: Native matrix host lock, two quiet samples 30 seconds apart, complete 300-second cooldown after every leg; native admission/lifecycle/cooldown logic preserved with two post-window monotonic witness writes around the existing cooldown sleep. No override to make a loaded host pass.

overhead.primary: For each metric, median of three process-leg medians; every process median uses its four native round values.
overhead.secondary: Median of all twelve native round values per arm.
overhead.pass: All four hierarchical/pooled metric regressions must be <=2%; retain every pair difference and all 24 rounds.

coverage: Complete unique 700 x 4 observer outcomes for every arm. Probe additionally requires complete member/writer/read/decode/classify/event joins, exact first eligible chunk/frame byte equality, all partial accepted write ranges, no failed batches, no trace buffer overflow, and no early writer shutdown/reconnect. Changed-gap maps use trigger to each observer completion without a trailing gap; all-observer maps use the full round window including the trailing gap. Both maps retain every tied maximum and reconstruct their own unchanged native columns.

clock.cross_process_requirement: All clock brackets must overlap a consistent monotonic-to-realtime epoch mapping; publication reader cross_process_clock_qualified must be true. These anchors do not measure all intervening wall-clock behavior.

buffers: Four first-generation receiver rows and writer batches per observer; at most 64 poll_write results per batch; publication rows bounded to 8192 chunks/group; reject overflow. Output only after measured rounds/at shutdown. Writer Drop emits a same-daemon-clock dump timestamp; its earliest clock bound must follow the final measured reload window.
repeatability: Publish per-round p50/p95/max and slowest 5% observer membership, preserving process identity. Name a separated component dominant only if its phase ranking repeats across all three independent probe processes. Signed cross-process intervals retain bracket bounds; do not sum phase quantiles.
method_retry: If overhead, joins, clocks, or process repeatability fails, retain rejected/null evidence and reduce or replace the measurement method at most once; never relax the gate.
functional_smoke: A small same-four-round trace validates both harness arms with RELOADSTALL_EVIDENCE_DIR explicitly unset and a full 300-second cooldown after each arm; it is never timing evidence and requires the root lab slot.
control_observer: Frozen 49abbb017 harness plus the same post-round allobserver outcome map and clock brackets as probe; no receiver capture storage, atomics, stream counters, or polling wrapper. Daemon control is clean default-feature 49abbb017.
